statement: An entry for a document the store does not hold never evicts one it holds: such entries have a bound of their own in each family (`maxAbsentApps`, `maxAbsentTenants`) and evict only each other, so however many ids without a document a client names, every document a family holds within its bound stays installed.
guards: runtime:DocumentSnapshotSourceTest#a flood of ids without a document never evicts a document
